steps.description: Capture control state, actor, change record, and adjacent telemetry.
Confirm whether the change is authorized and identify the accountable owner.
Recommend host isolation if malicious activity is corroborated.
steps.rollback: Release isolation after clean validation and owner approval.

steps.description: Restore the impaired security control through authorized administration.
steps.rollback: Return to the last approved control configuration.

steps.description: Hunt for the same actor, command, indicator, and control change across the estate.
Preserve sign-in, token, endpoint, mail, and administrative audit evidence.
Recommend revocation of active sessions and refresh tokens.
Recommend temporary account disablement if active misuse is corroborated.
steps.rollback: Restore only after identity proofing and credential reset.

steps.description: Reset credentials and re-register phishing-resistant MFA.
Review group membership, delegated access, OAuth grants, and mailbox rules.
Record affected hosts, identities, process tree, files, shares, and timestamps.
Recommend isolation of corroborated affected hosts.
steps.rollback: Release isolation only after eradication validation.

steps.description: Validate immutable backup availability and restrict destructive backup administration.
Measure affected assets, shares, identities, and recovery dependencies.
Recommend recovery from verified clean backups after eradication.
steps.rollback: Return to preserved recovery snapshot if validation fails.

steps.description: Preserve flow, proxy, DNS, endpoint, identity, and data-access telemetry.
Recommend blocking a confirmed malicious destination.
Recommend host isolation if transfer is active and unauthorized.
steps.rollback: Release after scope and eradication validation.

steps.description: Determine data type, owner, regulatory impact, and notification obligations.
Hunt for matching destinations, tools, identities, and staging behavior.
